mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS resStartTime, DATE_FORMAT(r_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS resEndTime, r_headcount AS resHeadcount FROM reservation WHERE s_idx = #{spaceIdx} AND r_status != 'CANCELLED' AND DATE(r_start_time) = #{date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (s_idx, u_idx, r_start_time, r_end_time, r_headcount, r_total_price, r_status, r_content, r_created, r_updated) VALUES (#{spcIdx}, #{userIdx}, #{resStartTime}, #{resEndTime}, #{resHeadcount}, #{resTotalPrice}, 'PENDING', '', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.r_idx AS resIdx, r.s_idx AS spcIdx, r.u_idx AS userIdx, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS resStartTime, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS resEndTime, r.r_headcount AS resHeadcount, r.r_total_price AS resTotalPrice, r.r_status AS resStatus, s.s_name AS spaceName, b.b_name AS branchName FROM reservation r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx = s.s_idx JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE r.u_idx = #{userIdx} ORDER BY r.r_idx DESC
